description: This file contains utility functions for managing and checking usage quotas such as storage, predictions, flows, and users within a subscription-based system. It includes functions to get current usage, check limits, update usage, and handle predictions with monthly renewal logic.

methods.name: getCurrentUsage
methods.description: Retrieves current storage and predictions usage for an organization, along with their limits, based on the organization's ID and subscription ID.

methods.name: checkUsageLimit
methods.description: Checks if the current usage exceeds the quota limits for flows or users, throws an error if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: updatePredictionsUsage
methods.description: Increments the predictions usage count in cache, with a TTL that resets monthly based on subscription creation date.

methods.name: checkPredictions
methods.description: Verifies if the predictions usage has exceeded the quota limit, throws an error if exceeded.

methods.name: updateStorageUsage
methods.description: Updates the total storage usage in cache for an organization.

methods.name: checkStorage
methods.description: Checks if the storage usage exceeds the storage limit, throws an error if exceeded.
